user.title: Select existing Venta device
user.description: Choose a LocalTuya humidifier and an existing HomeKit bridge. No device or pairing settings will be changed.

migrate_yaml.title: Migrate existing YAML configuration
migrate_yaml.description: Creates a Venta config entry for the next start; the existing HomeKit accessory stays active. First make and verify a backup. After migration, manually remove the entire venta_homekit_native section from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant. The new entry may show a setup error until restart; YAML remains authoritative. Restore the YAML from backup to roll back.

data.confirm_humidity: I verified the humidity sensor type

entities.title: Confirm associated entities
entities.description: Select every function explicitly. Only entities belonging to the same LocalTuya device are available.

reconfigure.title: Apply reviewed Venta changes after a backup
reconfigure.description: The existing HomeKit accessory is not changed live. Only its saved LocalTuya role mappings can change, and only on the same bridge. Save a verified backup first. A manual Home Assistant restart is required; bridge switching needs a separate canary.
